base: p_c^site(Z^4) <= 0.4344 (Gomes, Pereira and Sanchis, J. Appl. Probab. 2026, Table 1), used as theta_4(4345/10000) > 0
alternative_base: p_c^site(Z^3) <= 4427/10000 and Z^3 inside Z^4, used as theta_4(4428/10000) > 0; links (3972, 4428) and (3934, 3972) over 10000 join the chain at link 2
rule: G = largest open cluster; ties: the cluster containing the smallest index 8x1+4x2+2x3+x4; empty if fewer than 3 sites
checks_per_link: root: r_F(full face) >= q for 8 faces; 2040 entry laws (8 faces x 255 nonempty entry sets), each certified to dominate Bernoulli(q)^7 by an integer flow on the cover graph of {0,1}^7 (a monotone coupling) that is validated directly; exact integer arithmetic over all 2^16 block states
